accepted_scale_test.purpose: API scale/load test only; uniformly strained Si is not a production physical structure
accepted_scale_test.structure: diamond-Si conventional 10x10x10 uniformly scaled to 60 A

conclusion: A complete 60 A cell with 8000 atoms and 1.331 million probes fits one API request. The physical 59.73 A bulk candidate requires raising the server atom limit above 10648. Repeating the atomic graph for all 216 residues would be inefficient; graph or coefficient caching is required before a production full-grid run.
